reference.source_state: working-tree snapshot after v2 packed loads, scalar selection, and owned cast reuse
reference.purpose: Immutable immediate baseline before the consistent 2x continuation

target_policy: Each named operation must reach the target ratio of sklearn-default median to current median on every dataset. Fit alone is reported separately; fresh fit_query includes preparation. Paired-round counts compare corresponding interleaved rounds; halves divide retained rounds chronologically (the first half takes an odd extra round). These ratios and counts are measurements, not confidence bounds.
